title: useState and state snapshots: State is a snapshot for each render, so an event handler sees values captured by that render
description: A React 19 and TypeScript 5 offline walkthrough of usestate and state snapshots, with explicit state contracts, a reproducible defect and local regression tests.
objectives: Explain the state contract of usestate and state snapshots
